map.为什么压降要乘以 2？: Why multiply the voltage drop by 2?
map.因为电流需经相线与中性线（或两根相线）构成回路，来回导线上都会产生压降。单相回路: Because current must pass through the phase and neutral (or two phase wires) to form a loop, and both legs produce a drop. The single-phase loop times 2 is the total round-trip drop; the three-phase three-wire should use sqrt(3) times I times R; this tool models the single-phase loop, for three-phase convert separately.
map.线损卡片显示的数字单位对吗？: Is the line-loss card unit correct?
map.工具「线损功率」卡片实际显示的是 kW 值（即 线损瓦数/1000），但标注为: The tool line-loss power card actually displays kW (i.e. line-loss watts/1000) but is labeled W. In the example the real line loss is 414 W, the card shows 0.41. Read it as kW. In daily design the 5% drop limit and line loss are hard constraints; long loops are often controlled by drop rather than current capacity, and this tool exposes that.
